title: Level Architecture, Spatial Pacing & Topological Continuity
core_competencies: Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) spatial generation with strict AABB non-overlapping bounds.
Threshold collision clearance insets (>= 0.20m) on all corridor sockets.
Pacing through spatial contrast: tight subterranean conduit choke points transitioning into expansive market squares.
Visual anchoring: placing 'weenies' (tall towers, illuminated central fountains) to orient the player without relying exclusively on the minimap.
Multi-tier elevations: linking surface squares (Y=0.0) with subterranean aqueducts (Y=-4.5) via sloped curbs and connecting stairs.
anti_patterns: Detached floating slabs with void gaps.
Corridor sockets misaligned with target room dimensions.
Occluding ground slabs blocking lower elevation visibility.
